tools.name: search_property
tools.description: Find candidate properties by address or postcode. Always call this first and confirm the match with the user before running other tools — never guess which property was meant.

tools.name: get_property_summary
tools.description: One-call overview of a property: EPC headline, last sale, flood risk, LPA, planning-risk score and council tax band. Start here after disambiguating with search_property.

tools.name: get_epc_history
tools.description: All EPC certificates lodged for a property over time, with floor area, room counts and rating per certificate. A floor-area jump between certificates with no matching planning record is the single highest-value red flag for a cash buyer.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: HM Land Registry Price Paid transaction history for a property or postcode.

tools.name: get_area_market
tools.description: UK House Price Index and local market trend (price growth, transaction velocity, property mix) for a postcode area.

tools.name: get_flood_risk
tools.description: Environment Agency flood zone (river/sea) and surface-water risk for a property, reported separately. Returns an explicit absent state rather than a false "low" when EA has no data for the location.

tools.name: get_planning_history
tools.description: Nearby planning applications and decisions, plus a rule-based planning approval-likelihood score for the area.

tools.name: get_broadband
tools.description: Ofcom broadband and mobile coverage for a postcode. Requires a HouseData API key. Live-checked per call, so this can take several seconds — do not call it in a tight loop over many postcodes.

tools.name: get_prism_score
tools.description: Housedata PRISM score: identifies where a property's features (extensions, conversions, floor-area changes) lack a corresponding planning/building-control record, with remediation paths. Requires an active HouseData API key — if the account is not entitled, the error explains how to upgrade.

tools.name: check_epc_compliance
tools.description: Batch-checks up to 50 properties (by id or postcode) against Minimum Energy Efficiency Standard (MEES) 2030 thresholds and flags expired certificates. Use for landlord portfolio compliance sweeps.

tools.name: get_grants
tools.description: Energy-efficiency and home-improvement grant schemes a property may be eligible for, based on EPC rating, council tax band, tenure and income band.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_property" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
